Case A: A pharmacist maintains a CDTM agreement but completes only the general 20 annual CE hours, with no additional agreement-related hours.

Case B: The pharmacist later obtains prescribing authority under the agreement and overlooks the separate periodic pain-management training requirement.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The CDTM framework adds at least five relevant hours to the general annual requirement.
Pain-management training can never contribute to the additional CDTM hours.
CDTM prescribing authority eliminates all periodic pain-management training requirements.
Ending the year's CE courses permits immediate disposal of all agreement-related evidence.

explanation.core_reasoning: CDTM의 CE는 일반 20시간에 5시간을 추가하는 연간 총 25시간 구조다. Prescriptive authority가 있으면 해당 2년마다 최소 1시간의 pain-management training 조건도 확인한다. 인정되는 CE credit이면 추가 5시간에 산입할 수 있는 경로를 구분한다. CPA 관련 CE 증빙 보존과 일반 CE 보존 의무를 각각 충족한다.

choice_analysis.A: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. CDTM의 CE는 일반 20시간에 5시간을 추가하는 연간 총 25시간 구조다.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 인정되는 CE credit이면 추가 5시간에 산입할 수 있는 경로를 구분한다.
교정된 설명: Accepted pain-management CE may contribute to the additional five hours when its conditions are met.
choice_analysis.C:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Prescriptive authority가 있으면 해당 2년마다 최소 1시간의 pain-management training 조건도 확인한다.
교정된 설명: Prescribing CDTM pharmacists have a separate stated pain-management training obligation.
choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. CPA 관련 CE 증빙 보존과 일반 CE 보존 의무를 각각 충족한다.
교정된 설명: Relevant CE evidence must be retained under the applicable agreement and CE-record rules.

Case B: The pharmacist compares CDTM's MassHealth participation-or-application attestation with a different prescribing circular that merely encourages enrollment.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: Any CPA grants retail authority to prescribe Schedule II–V drugs.
An encouraged-enrollment statement in another pathway removes CDTM's attestation requirement.
Reporting a restriction to the Board necessarily replaces notice to every supervising physician.
Applicable MCSR and federal registration requirements must be considered separately from the CPA.

교정된 설명: Retail Schedule II–V prescribing restrictions remain despite a CPA.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. CDTM의 participation/application attestation과 다른 circular의 encouraged 표현을 구분한다.
교정된 설명: A mandatory CDTM attestation is not converted to a recommendation by language in another prescribing pathway.

Case B: Another patient is managed on an appropriate Schedule VI therapy, and the pharmacist assumes that Schedule VI status removes any additional reporting duties.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case B? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: A physician can waive the retail Schedule II–V prescribing restriction in a CPA.
Schedule VI status alone allows treatment of any disease without referral.
Schedule VI status does not by itself remove special PMP or other product requirements.
A non-opioid drug must be Schedule VI for retail CDTM purposes.

선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 계약 문구로 retail의 Schedule II–V prescribing 금지를 없앨 수 없다.
교정된 설명: The retail prohibition on prescribing Schedules II–V is not removed by agreement language.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. Schedule 하나로 환자·질환·협약 조건을 대체하지 않는다.
교정된 설명: An eligible Schedule VI therapy still needs the appropriate diagnosis and CPA authority.
choice_analysis.C: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Gabapentin처럼 Schedule VI이면서 추가 PMP 조건이 있는 제품을 구분한다.
choice_analysis.D:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 약리학적 분류와 legal schedule은 다르다.
교정된 설명: Testosterone's non-opioid character does not change its controlled-substance schedule.

Case A: A CDTM pharmacist modifies a patient's prescription on Monday and plans to send the copy to the supervising physician with the next monthly report.

Case B: An urgent safety issue occurs after the change, and the pharmacist decides to wait until the ordinary copy-transmission period ends before notifying the physician.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

choices.text: The stated prescription or modification copy is provided within 24 hours after issuance.
The 24-hour limit requires waiting a full day before urgent communication.
A dispensing label alone replaces the CDTM medical-record documentation.
A generic instruction to contact as needed replaces all required communication terms.

choice_analysis.A: 선택해야 하는 옳은 설명. Issuance 후 24시간 이내 사본 전달과 월간 보고는 다르다.
choice_analysis.B:
선택하지 않아야 하는 잘못된 설명. 최대 기한이 있다는 것은 그때까지 기다리라는 뜻이 아니다.
교정된 설명: Urgent circumstances call for communication sooner than the ordinary limit.

Case B: The physician and pharmacist add a sentence allowing a technician to make independent therapeutic decisions and assume the agreement expands the technician's statutory scope.

Which conclusion correctly addresses Case A? Select ONE answer.

A CPA never requires renewal once both parties sign.
The agreement need not identify any prescribing authority or outcome measures.
Signatures alone do not replace the required substantive CPA terms.
